statement: Every order-three element of the full three-cusp loop-outer group has global orientation multiplier one. Every finite subgroup of that full group has multiplier image in the global units {1,-1}, determined by its 2-adic coordinate. For each genus g>=2 and prime p, the actual automorphism group's primary homology map is injective on every finite p-subgroup.
manuscript_passages: Part D: full loop-outer actions of type (0,3)
notes: The full closed-surface lemma concerns actual automorphisms and is applied only after D27 supplies the actual order-three lift. Its proof uses the named full-to-pro-p quotient on cohomology, the fundamental class and its nondegenerate cup pairing, Brown restriction in virtual dimension two, and a complete closed-subgroup index argument. The cyclic cover and all filling maps are specified. The identity after filling contradicts the same orientation multiplier on the closed fundamental line; no profinite braid-kernel recognition is used.
